name: Chest press machine
instructions: Adjust the seat so handles sit around mid-chest.
Press smoothly while keeping shoulders supported; return under control.

name: Incline dumbbell press
instructions: Use a moderate bench incline and stable feet.
Lower dumbbells in control and press upward without bouncing.

name: Pec deck fly
instructions: Set the seat so arms move at chest height.
Bring arms together without shrugging; return slowly.

name: Cable chest fly
instructions: Stand stable with a soft elbow bend.
Bring hands together in a smooth arc; do not overstretch shoulders.

name: Incline dumbbell fly
instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding dumbbells above the chest with palms facing inward.
Keep a gentle bend in the elbows as you open your arms to the sides.
Stop at a comfortable chest stretch, then bring the weights together in an arc without pressing.

name: Flat dumbbell bench press
instructions: Keep feet stable and shoulder blades supported.
Lower weights in control; press without clashing dumbbells.

name: Push-up
instructions: Keep a straight line from head to heels or knees.
Lower under control and push away without sagging hips.

name: Barbell bench press
instructions: Set up stable feet and shoulder blades, and use collars.
Lower bar with control; use a spotter or safeties when appropriate.

name: Leg press machine
instructions: Sit with back and hips supported; place feet securely.
Press without locking knees; lower only while pelvis stays stable.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
instructions: With slightly bent knees, hinge hips backward and keep weights close.
Stand tall through the hips without overextending the back.

name: Seated leg curl
instructions: Align knee joints with the machine pivot and secure pads.
Curl smoothly and return slowly without lifting hips.

name: Lying leg curl
instructions: Align knees near the pivot; keep pelvis against the pad.
Bend knees under control; avoid swinging the weight.

name: Standing calf raise (machine)
instructions: Stand on the machine platform with the balls of your feet supported and shoulders under the pads.
Lift your heels steadily, pause, then lower under control.

name: Seated calf raise (machine)
instructions: Sit at the calf raise machine with the thigh pads adjusted comfortably.
Raise your heels to lift the load, then lower under control.

name: Kettlebell goblet squat
instructions: Hold a kettlebell with both hands at chest height.
Sit down between the hips, keeping heels grounded and knees tracking toes.
Stand tall while keeping the weight close to your chest.

name: Leg extension machine
instructions: Align knee joint to the machine pivot and adjust ankle pad.
Extend knees smoothly; lower under control.

name: Hip thrust / glute drive machine
equipment: hip thrust or glute drive machine
instructions: Set padding securely across the hips and keep ribs stacked.
Drive through feet until hips extend; avoid excessive back arch.

name: Dumbbell hip thrust
instructions: Rest the upper back securely on a bench and pad the dumbbell at the hips.
Lift hips through glutes without hyperextending the back.

name: Bulgarian split squat
instructions: Place rear foot on a low bench and find a stable stance.
Bend front knee slowly, keep balance, and drive through the front foot.

name: Lat pulldown
instructions: Set thigh pad firmly and keep chest comfortably lifted.
Pull bar toward upper chest while driving elbows down; return smoothly.

name: Neutral-grip lat pulldown
equipment: lat pulldown machine with neutral grip
instructions: Take a palms-facing grip and steady the torso.
Pull elbows toward the ribs; avoid leaning backward excessively.

name: Chest-supported machine row
instructions: Adjust chest pad and reach for handles without rounding excessively.
Pull elbows backward; return with control and without jerking.

name: Seated cable row
instructions: Sit tall with stable feet and a slight knee bend.
Draw handle toward the torso without rocking backward; return slowly.

name: Reverse pec deck / rear delt fly
instructions: Set seat so hands align with shoulders.
Open arms to the sides while keeping neck relaxed; return slowly.

name: Single-arm dumbbell row
instructions: Support the body with one hand and keep the spine stable.
Pull dumbbell toward hip without twisting; lower under control.

name: Straight-arm cable pulldown
instructions: Set a stable stance with slight elbow bend.
Pull handle toward thighs using shoulders and lats; avoid swinging.

name: One-arm seated cable row
instructions: Sit at the cable row station and hold one handle with the arm extended.
Pull your elbow toward your lower ribs without twisting your shoulders.
Extend in control and complete both sides.

name: Back extension
instructions: Adjust support below the hips and brace the torso.
Hinge forward within comfort and rise to a neutral straight line.

name: Assisted pull-up machine
instructions: Select enough assistance to move smoothly.
Pull chest toward handles and lower with control; never drop.

name: Cable face pull
instructions: Pull a rope toward eye level with elbows high but comfortable.
Keep shoulders down and resist shrugging; return slowly.

name: Shoulder press machine
instructions: Set seat so handles begin near shoulder height.
Press up without over-arching lower back; lower in control.

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
instructions: With soft elbows, lift arms out to shoulder level or comfortable range.
Avoid swinging and lower slowly.

name: Cable triceps pushdown (bar)
instructions: Attach a short straight bar to the upper cable pulley and stand facing it.
Hold your upper arms near your body and press the bar down by extending your elbows.
Return slowly without swinging or shifting your shoulders.

name: Dumbbell hammer curl
instructions: Stand stable with palms facing inward.
Curl elbows without swinging torso and lower in control.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Sit supported and begin weights near shoulder level.
Press overhead without shrugging or excessive back arch.

name: EZ-bar biceps curl
instructions: Keep upper arms near the sides and wrists comfortable.
Curl without rocking the torso; lower smoothly.

name: Plate-loaded lateral raise
instructions: Adjust the seat so the upper-arm pads line up with your shoulders.
Press outward and upward against the pads until your upper arms approach shoulder height.
Lower slowly while staying against the back support.

name: Overhead cable triceps extension
instructions: Keep upper arms steady and elbows comfortable.
Extend elbows smoothly; avoid arching the back.

name: Cable biceps curl
instructions: Stand tall with elbows near the torso.
Curl against cable tension and lower without leaning.

name: Cable lateral raise
instructions: Stand stable beside the cable with soft elbow.
Raise arm to a comfortable shoulder height; lower without twisting.

name: Biceps curl machine
instructions: Align elbow with the machine pivot and rest upper arms on pads.
Curl smoothly; lower without letting shoulders roll.

name: Triceps extension machine
instructions: Adjust seat and arm support to your height.
Extend elbows under control and return slowly.

name: Forearm plank
instructions: Keep ribs stacked over your pelvis and avoid arching the back.
Breathe normally; finish when you can no longer hold good alignment.

name: Side plank
instructions: Stack the shoulders and hips and keep your trunk straight.
Change sides each set and stop if the shoulder feels painful.

name: Dead bug
instructions: Keep the lower back supported without forcing it flat.
Extend opposite arm and leg slowly; breathe out as you reach.

name: Bird dog
instructions: Keep your pelvis steady on hands and knees.
Reach opposite arm and leg without twisting through the torso.

name: Bicycle crunch
instructions: Rotate gently from your rib cage, not your neck.
Extend the opposite leg in control, breathing out on each turn.

name: Reverse crunch
instructions: Roll the pelvis slightly upward rather than swinging the legs.
Keep the movement small and lower under control.

name: Hanging knee raise
instructions: Start with still shoulders and avoid swinging.
Lift knees toward your torso, then lower slowly.

name: Kneeling cable crunch
instructions: Keep hips mostly fixed as the rib cage curls toward the pelvis.
Move slowly and avoid pulling with the arms.

name: Cable Pallof press
instructions: Stand sideways to the cable with soft knees.
Press hands forward without allowing the torso to rotate.

name: Mountain climbers
instructions: Keep hands under shoulders and maintain a firm trunk.
Drive knees forward at a speed that preserves your position.

name: Ab wheel rollout
instructions: Brace the abdomen and keep the pelvis from tipping forward.
Roll only as far as you can return with control.

name: Hollow body hold
instructions: Keep your lower ribs down and spine supported.
Bend your knees or keep arms by your sides to reduce difficulty.

name: Russian twist
instructions: Sit tall with a braced trunk and relaxed shoulders.
Rotate gently from the torso without jerking side to side.

name: Standing quadriceps stretch
instructions: Stand near a support and keep your knees close together.
Move gently until a comfortable stretch; repeat the other side.

name: Hamstring stretch on bench
instructions: Rest one heel on the bench and keep your back long.
Hinge a little at the hips; do not bounce.

name: Couch stretch
instructions: Pad the knee and adopt a comfortable upright position.
Keep hips square; ease off if the knee feels strained.

name: Pigeon stretch
instructions: Support your hips with a cushion if needed.
Use a pain-free range and avoid forcing the front knee.

name: Child's pose
instructions: Reach the arms forward and breathe into the back.
Widen knees or use a cushion to stay comfortable.

name: Cat–cow mobility
instructions: Begin on hands and knees with shoulders relaxed.
Move slowly through a comfortable arch and round, breathing steadily.

name: Doorway chest stretch
instructions: Place forearm against a doorway below shoulder height.
Step forward gradually without straining your shoulder.

name: Thread the needle
instructions: From all fours, reach one arm under your body.
Let the upper back rotate while hips stay reasonably steady.

name: Gentle cobra stretch
instructions: Support yourself on forearms or hands as comfortable.
Keep shoulders relaxed; avoid pinching the lower back.

name: Seated spinal twist
instructions: Sit tall and turn from the upper body.
Keep the movement gentle and avoid yanking the knee.

name: Butterfly stretch
instructions: Bring soles together and sit on a folded towel if needed.
Let knees drop naturally; do not press them down.

name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
instructions: Draw one arm lightly across the chest.
Keep shoulder low and avoid stretching into sharp pain.

name: Downward-facing dog
instructions: Press through hands and keep your spine long.
Bend knees if needed; do not force heels to the floor.

name: Kneeling hip flexor stretch
instructions: Pad the back knee and gently tuck the pelvis.
Shift forward slightly until you feel a front-of-hip stretch.

name: Standing calf stretch
instructions: Put one foot behind with heel on the floor.
Keep the rear knee straight and lean forward gently.

name: Bodyweight squat
instructions: Keep your whole foot planted and sit between your knees.
Stand up smoothly without letting knees collapse inward.

name: Reverse lunge
instructions: Step back with enough distance to keep balance.
Lower vertically and push through the front leg to return.

name: Glute bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with feet hip-width apart.
Lift hips using your glutes without arching your lower back.

name: Step-ups
instructions: Choose a stable step at a comfortable height.
Drive through the leading foot and step down under control.

name: Walking lunges
instructions: Take an easy, stable step forward.
Lower under control; keep your trunk upright.

name: Bear crawl
instructions: Hover knees just above the ground with a neutral spine.
Take small opposite-hand/foot steps without rocking side to side.

name: Superman floor raise
instructions: Lie face down with arms stretched out in front.
Raise arms, chest and legs slightly at the same time, pause, then lower.
Repeat slowly without arching excessively through the back.

name: Burpees
instructions: From standing, squat and place your hands on the floor.
Step or hop your feet back to a plank, then return to standing.
Add a jump if comfortable; the illustration shows a standard burpee rather than a step-back variation.

name: Jump squat
instructions: Use a shallow, comfortable squat before the jump.
Land softly with bent knees; skip jumping if joints object.

name: Wall sit
instructions: Slide down the wall to a comfortable knee angle.
Breathe steadily and stop if knee pain develops.

name: Inchworm walkout
instructions: Hinge forward and walk hands out into a plank.
Keep hips steady as you walk back toward your feet.

name: Glute kickback (floor)
instructions: Keep the pelvis level on hands and knees.
Press one heel back and up without arching your spine.

name: Machine hip abduction
instructions: Sit upright in the hip abduction machine with the pads outside your thighs.
Open your thighs against the resistance without leaning or bouncing.
Return with control, without letting the weight stack slam.

name: Cable pull-through
instructions: Face away from a low cable with feet planted.
Hinge back at the hips, then stand by squeezing glutes.

name: Dumbbell sumo squat
instructions: Stand wide with toes slightly turned out and hold a dumbbell vertically between your legs.
Bend your knees in line with the toes and lower into a comfortable squat.
Stand tall again without rounding the lower back.

name: High-foot leg press
instructions: Place feet higher while keeping full foot contact.
Lower only as far as your pelvis stays supported.

name: Single-leg hip thrust
instructions: Keep hips level with one foot firmly on the floor.
Drive through the heel and avoid rotating the pelvis.

name: Smith machine hip thrust
instructions: Place the upper back securely against a bench.
Drive hips upward and avoid overextending at the top.

name: Cable glute kickback
instructions: Set an ankle cuff at the lowest pulley position.
Extend the hip slightly without arching your lumbar spine.

name: Rowing machine
instructions: Drive first through the legs, then lean slightly and pull.
Recover arms, torso and then knees; keep breathing evenly.

name: Jumping jacks
instructions: Jump or step your feet apart while bringing your arms overhead.
Return feet and arms to the starting position in a controlled rhythm.
A step-out is a lower-impact alternative; the illustration depicts the standard jumping movement.

name: Jump rope
instructions: Keep elbows close and turn the rope with your wrists.
Make soft, small jumps, or mimic the movement without a rope.

name: High knees
instructions: Stand tall and lift alternating knees toward hip height, pumping your arms.
Quickly switch legs while staying upright and landing gently.
March in place as a lower-impact alternative; the illustration depicts the faster drill.

name: Stationary bike
instructions: Set saddle height so knees remain slightly bent at the bottom.
Pedal at a pace where breathing is controlled.

name: Air bike
instructions: Adjust the seat and keep shoulders relaxed.
Use legs and handles smoothly; reduce effort when breathing hard.

name: Stair climber
instructions: Step upright using the rails lightly for balance.
Start with a sustainable pace instead of sprinting.

name: Suitcase carry
instructions: Carry a weight in one hand and stand tall.
Walk without leaning to the loaded side; change hands.

name: Kettlebell swing
instructions: Hinge at the hips; keep the kettlebell close.
Snap hips forward without lifting with the shoulders; learn the technique first.

name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
instructions: Keep hips square while reaching the free leg back.
Hinge only as far as you can stay balanced and steady.

name: Step-up to balance
instructions: Choose a low stable platform and keep your trunk tall.
Step up, briefly balance, then lower slowly.

name: Cossack squat
instructions: Move sideways into a comfortable hip hinge.
Keep the working foot grounded and reduce depth as needed.

name: World's greatest stretch
instructions: Take a long lunge with hands supported on the floor.
Rotate gently toward the front leg; switch sides.
